verdict.rationale: Document AI is documented as API-first: OCR, table formatting, header/footer extraction, block extraction, confidence scores, bbox and document annotations, and Document QnA are all exposed as API parameters. It also has a batch endpoint and official Python/TypeScript SDKs, while the playground serves as a UI front-end. A hands-on user found the API handled large jobs that the Le Chat interface could not. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of UI/API feature parity, a publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec (the probe found 404s at all candidate paths), and documentation of whether playground-only features exist.
